metadata.title: Palantir Stock: Why Signing a Deal With Mexico’s Top Insurer Is a Big Deal<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Palantir Signs a Deal With Mexico’s Top Insurer to Boost Commercial Business. Will It Boost the Stock?
Fresh off its worst month in five years, Palantir Technologies has unveiled its first commercial customer in Mexico, marking an expansion beyond the massive defense contracts that built its reputation.
